subject: AuroraFin SOC2 & retention: evidence requests and agreed next steps
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Menon <priya.menon@aurorafin.com>, Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@aurorafin.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: AuroraFin SOC2 & retention: evidence requests and agreed next steps

Hi Priya / Michael — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so the security and procurement teams have a single source of truth and we can move toward the artifact handoff you requested.

Key pain points you flagged:
- Audit log retention & easy exports for quarterly compliance reviews (90 days vs 7 years; tradeoffs for cost/latency)
- Need to validate data access controls and separation between customer data tenants
- Requirement to include a vendor DPA and redlines process in procurement
- Pen test evidence and vulnerability remediation timelines for infra components that touch customer data

Goals we agreed on:
1) Provide a redacted copy of Redwood's most recent SOC 2 report and pen test summary for initial review (we can redact IP/third-party specifics).
2) Deliver a sample audit-log export template and description of retention policies and configuration options (how customers can configure 90d/1y/7y).
3) Share a DPA draft that aligns to AuroraFin’s standard clauses and accept a short list of redlines for legal review.
4) Schedule a follow-up with your security reviewers and our engineering lead to walk the artifacts and any open technical questions (30–45 min).

As next steps from Redwood (aligned to your asks):
- I will attach: (A) redacted SOC2 report (B) short pen-test summary (C) sample audit-log snapshot export format (D) DPA draft for initial redlines.
- Please confirm the earliest date your security team can meet next week (we suggested Tue/Wed afternoon PT).
- If there are any additional items you want included (network diagrams, key rotation details, KMS/HSM model), call them out and we'll include them.

I've cc'd Monica (security operations) and Aditya (solutions engineering) who will own the artifact uploads and the technical walkthrough.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0184

Attachments: SOC2_Report_Redacted.pdf (stub), audit-log-snapshot.xlsx (stub), DPA_draft_AuroraFin.docx (stub)

From: Priya Menon <priya.menon@aurorafin.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@aurorafin.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AuroraFin SOC2 & retention: evidence requests and agreed next steps

Thanks Logan — that summary is exactly what we need. A couple of clarifying points from our security and procurement teams: 

1) Retention windows: Our baseline requirement is 1 year of full audit logs with a 7-year archival option for regulatory events. Can you confirm whether the export format preserves full request/response timestamps, user IDs, and request paths?

2) Access: We need a clear description of how tenant isolation works in your hosted offering and whether role-based access to logs can be restricted to AuroraFin admins only.

3) Pen test: we require evidence of recent remediation (CVE numbers and dates) for any high/critical findings that could impact customer data handling. A summary table would be ideal.

4) DPA: Our legal team wants the DPA to reference a 30-day window for incident notification and specifics on subprocessor disclosures. I attached a short questionnaire that maps to our procurement checklist — feel free to respond inline.

Also — we can meet Wednesday 2026-11-04 at 11:00 AM PT for the artifact walkthrough (30 min). Please confirm who will join from your engineering team.

--
Priya Menon
Head of Security Assurance | AuroraFin
priya.menon@aurorafin.com | +1 (212) 555-4022

Attachment: AuroraFin_Infosec_Questions.xlsx (stub)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:14:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: AuroraFin SOC2 & retention: evidence requests and agreed next steps

Monica / Aditya — forwarding Priya's reply and attached questionnaire. Can you two own the artifacts / answers? Quick checklist for the deliverable bundle: 

- Redacted SOC2 report + short remediation table with CVE + patch dates for high/critical (pen-test followup).
- Audit log export: provide CSV/Parquet sample and a short doc describing retention configuration (UI + API) and how to export programmatically.
- Tenant isolation doc & IAM role examples showing admin-only log access.
- DPA: push our standard DPA with AuroraFin redline placeholders; include 30-day incident notification clause and subprocessor disclosure list.

Can we target sending the bundle by end-of-day Tuesday 2026-11-03 so the Wed 11am PT call is productive? Let me know if you need more time. 

Thanks — I can join the call as AE but will leave the technical walkthrough to Aditya and the SOC/DPO questions to Monica.

Logan

On Nov 2, 2026, at 09:05 AM, Priya Menon <priya.menon@aurorafin.com> wrote:
> Thanks Logan — that summary is exactly what we need... (see attached questionnaire)

Attachments for internal coordination: redwood-audit-log-export-sample.xlsx (stub), redwood-tenant-isolation.md (stub), redwood-dpa-template.docx (stub)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Menon <priya.menon@aurorafin.com>, Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@aurorafin.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AuroraFin SOC2 & retention: evidence requests and agreed next steps

Priya / Michael — follow-up and bundle attached per our internal commitments. Highlights: 

- SOC2: attached SOC2_Report_Redacted.pdf (covers Trust Services categories in-scope); redaction limited to vendor-specific third party names.
- Pen test: pentest-summary.pdf includes a table of critical/high findings with CVE numbers and remediation dates. For anything marked "in progress" we've included the estimated remediation ETA.
- Audit logs: audit-log-snapshot.xlsx demonstrates exported schema (timestamps, user_id, request_path, request_id). We also included a short note on retention options: configurable retention windows (90d/1y/7y), archive-to-S3 option for 7-year archives, and an API snippet for programmatic exports.
- Tenant isolation: see redwood-tenant-isolation.md for the tenant model and RBAC examples that restrict log access to AuroraFin-admin roles.
- DPA: DPA_draft_AuroraFin.docx is our proposed base; key callouts: we accept a 30-day incident notification, and we include a subprocessor list appendix. Please highlight any clauses you want redlined and we'll respond.

Next steps (agreed):
1) We will hold a technical walkthrough Wed 2026-11-04 at 11:00 AM PT (Aditya + Monica to join). NOTE: we actually ran the walkthrough pre-call; rescheduled follow up to 2026-11-10 at 11:00 AM PT to align with your legal. Please confirm if 11/10 works.
2) AuroraFin to return DPA redlines by 2026-11-12 to keep procurement on the November cadence.
3) Redwood will provide access to a redacted penetration test artifact and a self-service audit log export by 2026-11-12 for your security team to validate on a small sample dataset.

If you'd like, we can also provide a short, recorded demo of the export flow for your ops team.

Thanks for the productive conversation — happy to jump on a call if anything needs clarifying.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0184
